name: Docker Live Restore Enabled
description: Ensures "live-restore": true, so containers keep running when the daemon is restarted or upgraded, reducing pressure to postpone security updates. Passes with LEA_RULE_no_service when dockerd is not running.

validation.command: if cat /proc/*/comm 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^dockerd$'; then cat /etc/docker/daemon.json 2>/dev/null; echo LEA_DOCKER; else echo 'LEA_RULE_no_service'; fi
